statements: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS jobs (id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, job_type VARCHAR(64), status VARCHAR(32), created_at DATETIME, updated_at DATETIME)

INSERT INTO jobs (job_type, status, created_at, updated_at) SELECT CONCAT('type_', FLOOR(RAND() * 10)), 'pending', NOW(), NOW() FROM (SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4) AS tmp
